from pricing import apply_discount, shipping_cost, is_free_shipping
import pytest

def test_apply_discount_percent_zero_and_hundred():
    assert apply_discount(100, 0) == 100
    assert apply_discount(100, 100) == 0

def test_apply_discount_invalid_low_and_high():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        apply_discount(100, -1)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        apply_discount(100, 101)

def test_shipping_cost_weight_zero_and_negative():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        shipping_cost(0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        shipping_cost(-0.1)

def test_shipping_cost_weight_light_parcel_boundary():
    assert shipping_cost(1) == 4.0
    assert shipping_cost(1.0001) != 4.0


def test_shipping_cost_express_double():
    assert shipping_cost(1, express=True) == 8.0
    assert shipping_cost(6, express=True) == round((7.5 + (6-5)*1.2) * 2, 2)

def test_is_free_shipping_thresholds():
    assert is_free_shipping(50, False) == True
    assert is_free_shipping(49.99, False) == False
    assert is_free_shipping(25, True) == True
    assert is_free_shipping(24.99, True) == False


def test_shipping_cost_mutant_25():
    w = 5 + 0.125 / 1.2
    assert shipping_cost(w) == round(7.5 + (w - 5) * 1.2, 2)
